chapter: The 1949 band, breakup and later years
title: Withdrawing after 1949 and the dry period
summary: After 1949 he joined Carlos Gastell, regrouped, and never again had a fully organized band apart from the 1966-67 one.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: And that's when you went into business with Carlos?
That's when I joined Carlos for about six months.
With the thought that you would never play anymore, or what?

Well, I don't know. I sort of withdrew to regroup, because I had -- this experience had shaken me up quite a bit, the very fact that I let something get away from me, to get out of control. Because I was always in control before. And I had to really figure out, you know, what I wanted to do, if anything. Of course things were changing in music drastically then. You were -- it was a question of how far you wanted to go, you know, with what was going on, or if you wanted to stick by your convictions and -- it was a very tough period for me. And I think that was probably -- oh, I've had other bands since that I was very proud of, like the last band, in '66-'67, I was very happy with that band. That band was playing what I wanted to play and they were playing it the way I wanted it played, and they had the guys there that I wanted in the band, and so that was fine.
